records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: •Net sales for the three months ended June 30, 2023 increased by 31% to $810.7 million compared to $621.0 million for the same period in 2022.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Although module average selling prices in many global markets have generally declined for several years, module spot pricing in the United States, our primary market, remains elevated due to the rising demand for domestically manufactured modules as a result of the IRA.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: •Gross profit for the three months ended June 30, 2023 increased 42.0 percentage points to 38.3% from (3.7)% for the same period in 2022.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: In recent years, the cost of producing electricity from PV solar power systems has decreased to levels that are competitive with or below the wholesale price of electricity in many markets.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase in net cash used in operating activities was primarily driven by lower cash receipts from module sales and certain advance payments for raw materials in the current period, partially offset by higher expenditures for the construction of certain projects in Japan in the prior period.
